brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 full bases in a row (q=0–3), each with a hex-bin-third-drain bin filled with soil and planted (prop:1–4).

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1, set to irrigation mode, enters at q=3 and passes through bases q=3, 2, 1 and 0.
The pipe run passes through all four cells, and each cell's bin is a drain bin. The configurator doesn't model water flow, so it can't confirm that water reaches each bed.

requirements.requirement: Watertight / suitable for water and outdoor use
requirements.evidence: Not checked: the configurator checks fit only. Watertightness and material resistance to water and sun depend on the material and print, which it doesn't model.

finish.summary:
I built a four-cell planter in a straight row (bases at q=0–3, r=0). One irrigation-mode pipe run (run-1) enters the end cell at q=3 and passes straight through the bases of all four cells.

Because the pipe passes through every base, each cell has room only for a third-depth bin, so the beds are shallow. Each cell has a third-depth drain bin, filled with soil and planted with a cabbage seedling. I capped all the open faces with solid end caps and bolted the joints between neighbouring cells.

The build has 29 parts and needs about 1.8 kg of filament. The check passed with no rule issues, and the collision check came back clear.

The configurator checks only fit and collisions. It doesn't check whether the pipe joints or bins hold water, or how well the plastic stands up to water and sun.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
